test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate one word to substitute the given group of words.**

Symbols of royalty
solution:
The correct answer is **Regalia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Regalia: **royal rights or prerogatives; the emblems, symbols, or paraphernalia indicative of royalty.

 
 
• **Example: ***The Veterans Day parade included many members of the military in their **regalia**.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate word to substitute the given group of words is **'****regalia'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sceptre: **a decorated rod carried by a king or queen on ceremonial occasions as a symbol of their power
 
• **Relic: **an object, tradition, etc. from the past that still survives today
 
• **Emblem: **an object or the figure of an object symbolizing and suggesting another object or an idea
